steps.en: Installs missing Node, git, ripgrep and Docker, and sets up the local ArangoDB + memory-layer backend
steps.zh: 补装缺的依赖，配好本地 ArangoDB 与 memory layer 后端

steps.en: Parses every file with tree-sitter and stores symbols, calls and imports as a persistent graph
steps.zh: 用 tree-sitter 解析各文件，把符号、调用、import 存成持久图

steps.en: Register your coding agents with the graph
steps.zh: 把你的编码 agent 注册到这张图上

steps.en: Answers the agent's structural questions over MCP with bounded slices, session after session
steps.zh: 通过 MCP 用小块结构答案回应 agent 的提问，跨会话持续可用

value.en: The agent stops grepping and re-reading whole files to rediscover callers and blast radius every session
value.zh: agent 不用每个会话都靠 grep 和整文件重读去重新找调用方和影响面

sources: README.md: Try Ix / Install (curl -fsSL https://ix-infra.com/install.sh | sh; ix map .; ix mcp install)
README.md: How it works (tree-sitter, ArangoDB plus the memory layer run in Docker, three clients)
docs/prerequisites.md: what the installer checks and installs
docs/mcp.md: ix mcp install registers clients; ix mcp is the stdio MCP server
docker-compose.standalone.yml: arangodb + memory-layer services used by install.sh
